headline: Copper heads for its biggest weekly drop in 19 months due to the AI-driven collapse
summary: Copper fell to its lowest since March and was heading for its largest weekly decline in more than 19 months. Investor interest in the artificial intelligence sector continues to fade.
why: Copper is a key industrial metal used in electrical wiring and grid infrastructure, so demand expectations from technology and data-center buildouts affect its price.
why_moved: Copper fell as investor enthusiasm for AI-related investment waned, reducing expectations for related industrial demand.
original_headline: El cobre se encamina a su mayor caída semanal en 19 meses por el desplome de la IA
